# monotaur_component (Resource)

Manages a Monotaur component. Components represent services or systems that can be monitored.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "monotaur_label" "env" {
  text  = "production"
  color = "#E53935"
}

resource "monotaur_component" "api_server" {
  name      = "API Server"
  label_ids = [monotaur_label.env.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The display name of the component.

### Optional

- `business_hours_id` (String) ID of the business hours schedule associated with this component (to-one, optional).
- `label_ids` (List of String) IDs of labels associated with this component.
- `maintenance_window_ids` (List of String) IDs of maintenance windows associated with this component.
- `monitor_ids` (List of String) IDs of monitors associated with this component.

### Read-Only

- `create_date_time` (String) The RFC 3339 timestamp when the component was created (assigned by the API).
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the component (assigned by the API).
- `update_date_time` (String) The RFC 3339 timestamp when the component was last updated (assigned by the API).
